authority: ADR 0019 v0.5; operator requested live camera on 2026-10-31
target: Dedicated M4, fixed four-vCPU Linux Vision VM; existing authenticated SSH only
motion: Stationary Safe Stop; inference has no CARLA client, actuator or control method
transport: Four-byte big-endian JSON-header length, bounded JSON metadata, two length-bound JPEG payloads over existing SSH stdin; bounded typed JSON results on stdout
pairSemantics: Only 80–120 ms capture pairs enable AutoDrive. Other ordered bounded pairs run AutoSteer/AutoSpeed and explicitly invalidate AutoDrive; no timestamp resampling
calibration: Actual CARLA camera transform/intrinsics and local road plane determine H; raw-to-model C = inverse(upstream V) * H. Preserve upstream V. Geometric checks are not model accuracy validation
preprocessing: AutoDrive uses warped pair and ImageNet normalization; AutoSteer/AutoSpeed use top-crop 2:1, resize 1024x512, RGB CHW [0,1]
display: Separate live and processed images; overlays only on exact matched result frame. AutoSteer is predicted ego path, not lane markings; AutoSpeed uses path-relative L0–L3; nullable AutoDrive distance is a model estimate
latency: Host camera-callback arrival to result/display age only; not full capture-to-display latency
exclusions: Product DMG or full API/UI E2E
